added.summary: A held on-screen d-pad (`touchPad`) carries the way it reads as `data-dir-up`, `data-dir-right`, `data-dir-down` and `data-dir-left` (two on a diagonal, none in its dead middle), so a class lights the pressed arm: `group-data-dir-up/pad:bg-accent` on a child of a `group/pad` pad.

fixed.summary: An on-screen control that is disabled or hidden while a finger holds it reads as let go: before, it kept `active:` and its knob's place until it was a control again.
